question.en: Discuss the role of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) in promoting sustainable economic growth in developing economies.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) in promoting sustainable economic growth in developing economies.

modelAnswer.en: The IFC plays a critical role by providing capital, advisory services, and risk management to private enterprises. It helps mobilize private investment, improves the business environment, and supports infrastructure and climate-related projects, thereby fostering job creation and poverty reduction.
